data.text: Before we choose, can we agree on 10 tons each this month? That earns each of us $10,000 and leaves 50 tons, so next month’s stock reaches 100 whether the external replenishment happens or the remaining fish double. We can repeat that plan and check everyone’s catches afterward. Taking more might boost one month’s income, but it risks reducing future catches—or collapsing the lake if fewer than 5 tons remain. John, would you agree to 10 tons each?
